senses.sense_definition: werk dat je doet naast je belangrijkste activiteiten, zoals een studie of een andere baan

examples.text: Studenten hebben vaak een <w>bijbaantje</w> om hun studie te kunnen betalen.

target_lang_translations.en: Students often have a <w>side job</w> to be able to pay for their studies.
target_lang_translations.it: Gli studenti hanno spesso un <w>lavoretto</w> per potersi pagare gli studi.

examples.text: Hij zoekt een leuke <w>bijbaan</w> voor in de avonduren.

target_lang_translations.en: He is looking for a nice <w>part-time job</w> for the evening hours.
target_lang_translations.it: Cerca un bel <w>secondo lavoro</w> per le ore serali.

examples.text: Naast zijn vaste werk heeft hij een <w>bijbaan</w> in de horeca.

target_lang_translations.en: In addition to his permanent work, he has a <w>side job</w> in the catering industry.
target_lang_translations.it: Oltre al suo lavoro fisso ha un <w>secondo lavoro</w> nel settore della ristorazione.

target_lang_definitions.en: work that you do alongside your main activities, such as a study or another job
target_lang_definitions.it: Lavoro che si svolge accanto alle attività principali, come gli studi o un altro lavoro

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: a job done in addition to one's primary occupation
often used when referring to student work or secondary employment
specifically for work done by students alongside their studies

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: lavoro secondario o temporaneo, spesso per studenti
lavoro svolto oltre a quello principale
impiego a tempo parziale affiancato ad altre attività
